q1_issues.issue: The fused compound kind lantern_keeper is missing its head genus (Inheritance lantern_keeper keeper), which Compound concepts says is always emitted for a modifier_noun with a real head noun and a holding IS-A.

"Aelmere Keepers" is decomposed into (Member $x keeper) + (Possession $x aelmere), minting a per-member keeper kind from a capitalized plural label whose own capitalized run exceeds the bare class word.

q2_gaps: A proper noun premodifying a CAPITALIZED plural common-noun head ("Aelmere Keepers"): the proper-noun-premodifier rule (parse the head normally, link by Possession) and the capitalized-label rule (a run exceeding the bare class word is a name; a capitalized plural label is Name-only with no per-member kind) prescribe conflicting routes, and nothing in the instruction set selects between them.
notes: The agent-nominalization atoms on lantern_keeper are licensed because the symbol was fused from the surface, and CoAgent for the comitative "with"-phrase follows the participant-vs-means test. The definite plural correctly takes a group witness rather than Inheritance.
